purpose: Development-scale 25-toy frozen-v4.2 refmatched injection-extraction and length-scale study using the repository fSigPowExpQ truth family consistently across the four requested exposure lanes.

hps_gpr/gpr.py.instrumentation: explicit optimizer-restart random_state plus captured optimizer warnings

hps_gpr/io.py.instrumentation: propagation of optimizer seed and warning diagnostics into BlindPrediction

user_shorthand_resolution.reason: No literal fSigPowExp tag exists; the prior 2021 1% alternate lane is fSigPowExpQ. The distinct five-parameter repository tag fSigPow is not used.

optimizer_gate.selection_rule: maximum GP log marginal likelihood among a reproducible branch; never use pull, fitted amplitude, recovery, or epsilon-squared

bias_test.endpoint: Exploratory zero-signal mean-pull diagnostics over the 25 analyzed backgrounds; no subset is confirmatory.
bias_test.test: two-sided one-sample Student-t test against zero
bias_test.decision: material bias only when p<0.05 and absolute mean pull>=0.2
bias_test.other_zero_signal_tests: exploratory Holm correction across 20 scenario-mass cells
bias_test.scope: development diagnostic only; not CLs coverage or a production-card acceptance test

covariance_repair_audit.scope: Replay any accepted state using a non-Cholesky covariance repair or a raw relative minimum below -0.005 before scientific interpretation.
covariance_repair_audit.selection_rule: Covariance diagnostics may trigger a numerical audit but never selection by fitted amplitude or pull.

interpretation.truth_scope: The fSigPowExpQ smooth stress family is fitted independently to native 1% and native 10% sources and used consistently across all four lanes; it is not a physical background generator.
interpretation.pairwise_scope: Unpaired source/selection comparisons with expected normalization ratio 1.1296466007; not pure exposure tests.
interpretation.coverage_scope: Conditional 25-toy injection-extraction and fit-space study; not a coverage-calibrated limit band, exclusion, or scan-wide global calibration. Any CLs calculation governed by the card is asymptotic 90% CLs (alpha 0.1).
interpretation.exclusion_scope: Exclusion eligibility is defined solely by predeclared optimizer and covariance reproducibility checks. Pull, fitted amplitude, recovery, and epsilon-squared are never selection inputs; every reproducible numerical branch remains included independent of pull magnitude or boundary occupancy.
